checks.detail: 3 explicit real Supabase tests passed: anonymous read/write restrictions, committed changes delivered to two independent WebSocket clients, concurrent saves yield 200/409. Random test row cleaned.

checks.detail: Rollback-only PostgreSQL assertions pass. Final count 24, with zero INV-TEST or INV-DB-PROOF fixtures.

checks.detail: pnpm typecheck, build, test, lint and API test:e2e passed. Web 67 passed with 3 live tests skipped in ordinary run and executed separately; API 18 unit and 4 HTTP tests passed.
